action.action-desc: Mr. Green of Texas submitted the following resolution; which was referred to the Committee on House Administration

form.official-title: Honoring the life and legacy of Congressman Sylvester Turner, a tireless champion of Houston’s diverse communities.

whereas.text: Whereas Sylvester Turner was born and raised in Houston, Texas, earning his Bachelor of Arts in political science from the University of Houston and later a Juris Doctor from Harvard Law School;
Whereas, in 1989, Sylvester Turner was elected to the Texas House of Representatives, beginning a distinguished 27-year career in the Texas House of Representatives;
Whereas Representative Turner was named Speaker pro tem of the Texas House in 2003, a position he would hold for 6 years;
Whereas, in 2015, Sylvester Turner was elected the 62nd mayor of Houston;
Whereas, throughout Mayor Turner’s tenure in office, he worked unwaveringly to improve economic opportunity, critical infrastructure, and public safety in Houston;
Whereas Mayor Turner led Houston through both Hurricane Harvey in 2017 and the COVID–19 pandemic, 2 of the most challenging moments in the city’s history;
Whereas, in 2023, Mayor Turner was elected to the United States House of Representatives; and

Whereas Representative Turner represented Texas 18th Congressional District, a seat previously held by trailblazers including Barbara Jordan, Mickey Leland, Craig Washington, and Sheila Jackson Lee: Now, therefore, be it

section.text: That the House of Representatives acknowledges and honors the life and legacy of Congressman Sylvester Turner, a tireless champion of Houston’s diverse communities.
